answer_1.quote: we propose RareSyn, a medical knowledge-enhanced EHR synthesis framework for rare disease diagnosis... employing LLMs to rephrase the sampled imaps, thereby generating new EHRs for rare diseases.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic electronic health records (EHRs) for rare diseases

answer_2.quote: Table presents the Micro-F1 scores for disease diagnosis when training different models using only original EHRs, as well as with additional synthetic rare disease EHRs generated by RareSyne (Ours) or MedSyn, on both JARVIS-D and JarvisD2.

answer_4.quote: We conducted two tests with the assistance of three medical experts to manually verify the validity of the synthetic EHRs.
answer_4.guideline: Firstly, we randomly selected 20 synthetic EHRs for each rare disease... and asked the experts to verify if each synthetic EHR was medically accurate and corresponded to the target rare disease. Secondly, we created 20 pairs of real and synthetic EHRs... The experts were then tasked with distinguishing the synthetic EHR in each pair.
